# Saasaloy

> Saasaloy is a CLI that scaffolds a Cloudflare-native SaaS monorepo (Turborepo, Astro, Hono, Drizzle, Better Auth) and then copies features into it as source files the project owns, one `saasaloy add <module>` at a time. Every project ships agent skills in `.agents/skills/`. The owner approves the product brief and spec first, then approves the design. The agent then builds the local MVP without further questions.

This file is for an AI agent that wants to build a product with Saasaloy. An agent that wants to change Saasaloy itself reads `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` instead.

## Prerequisites

Check each one before the first command. A missing one stops the build partway.

- Node.js 24.15.0 or newer. `node --version` prints it. The CLI and a scaffold both declare `engines.node` `>=24.15.0`.
- pnpm 12.3.4. A scaffold pins it in `packageManager`, and `init --yes` runs `pnpm install` with it.
- A git identity: `git config user.name` and `git config user.email` both print a value. `init` makes the first commit with it, and the build commits each stage. Without one, `init` warns and skips its commit.
- Network access to the npm registry, for `npx saasaloy@latest` and `pnpm install`, and to `api.github.com` and `codeload.github.com`, where `saasaloy add` and `saasaloy list` read the modules. The CLI reads the modules at the release tag of its own version.
- `GITHUB_TOKEN` set to a GitHub token, so the module reads do not hit GitHub's anonymous limit of 60 requests an hour. With it the limit is 5000. `saasaloy list --json` alone downloads every module of the registry, more than 50, so one build passes 60 without a token.

## Start a project

Start with `init`. Confirm product scope and design before the build.

1. In the folder you were given, run `npx saasaloy@latest init . --force --yes --testing=tests-after`. `--force` lets `init` scaffold into a folder that is not empty. `--yes` runs `pnpm install` with no prompt, writes the local env files, and commits the scaffold on `main`. The tests-after mode makes `add` write the route tests the MVP needs.
2. Read the generated `AGENTS.md`, then run the `saasaloy-setup` skill from `.agents/skills/saasaloy-setup/SKILL.md`. Use the owner’s description first. Ask for missing facts, write `docs/product-brief.md` and `docs/product-spec.md`, and confirm both in a product read-back.
3. After product approval, run the `saasaloy-design` review. Propose the brand and generate mockup images for the landing page and main customer workflow. Ask the owner to approve the current round.
4. After design approval, set `autonomy: afk` unless the owner requests an attended build. Start `saasaloy-build` in the same session. Ask no questions during the unattended build.

No env file is needed. A missing `packages/env/.env` reads as empty, so every key takes its local default.

## When nobody can answer

- **No brief and no person in the session: stop.** When the folder holds no `product-brief.md` and nobody can answer the interview (the prompt says so, or you run headless), do not run the interview and do not write a brief yourself. Say "No product brief exists and nobody is here to answer the saasaloy-setup interview", and stop. A headless run whose prompt says the owner is here and answers your questions has a person: ask in text, end your turn, and read the answer in the next message.
- **A brief a person wrote earlier.** When the folder holds `product-brief.md` with `autonomy: afk` in its YAML frontmatter, run step 1, then `saasaloy-build`. It moves the brief to `docs/product-brief.md` and runs with no interview. A `product-spec.md` beside it moves to `docs/` too; with no spec, the build makes the MVP set and one entity from the brief. A brief without `autonomy: afk` needs a person to confirm it: with nobody to answer, stop and say so.

## What the reviews record

- `docs/product-brief.md`: the ten landing answers (Name, Language, Audience, Problem, Current alternative, Differentiator, Proof, Tone, Pricing, Where "sign up" goes). It is complete when all ten are filled and none is tagged `weak:`. The owner settles each thin answer at the read-back, and an accepted one is tagged `weak-accepted:` and counts as filled. With an incomplete brief the build stops before the first module and lists the gaps under `## Blocked` in `docs/build-log.md`.
- `docs/product-design.md` holds the approved design values and image references. `docs/product-approvals.json` records both approvals.
- `docs/product-spec.md`: the module picks from `saasaloy list --json`, one table for each entity (its fields, who may see it, its actions and its screens) in the owner's order, the wishes that are not in this build, and the steps left for the owner. The build makes each entity with one commit, with no limit on their number.
- Every CLI command runs with no terminal. A command that would prompt exits 2 and names the flag that answers it. `--json` prints one JSON document with `schemaVersion: 1`.
- Never invent a price, a proof, a customer name or a URL. The brief holds only what the owner said.

## What the build leaves

- One commit per stage, and one per spec entity, on the `build/mvp` branch. Nothing is pushed.
- `docs/build-log.md`, with one section per stage and per entity and its commit, a `## Blocked` list, and a `## Left for a human` list. A new session reads it first and continues.
- A deploy, a vendor account, a secret edit and a push stay a person's steps. A picked module that needs an account gets its local provider, and the vendor step goes to `## Left for a human`. With `deploy: preview`, the build records the choice and lists the preview deploy there too.
- No sign-up becomes the superadmin. Locally the seed's `superadmin@example.test` opens the admin app. Production's first superadmin is a person's step before the first deploy: `pnpm db:prod:superadmin`.

## Docs

- [All the docs in one file](https://saasaloy.com/llms-full.txt): every docs page of the site, in reading order, as one Markdown file.
- [Build with an agent](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/docs/wiki/how-to/build-with-an-agent.md): the prompt, the interview, the build log and the human steps.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/docs/wiki/getting-started.md): install the CLI and scaffold a project.
- [Modules](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/docs/wiki/modules.md): every module in the default registry. `saasaloy list --json` gives the same data with each module's `stage` and `needs`.
- [Reference](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/docs/wiki/reference.md): every command, flag and exit code.
- [Add a module](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/docs/wiki/how-to/add-a-module.md) and [Remove a module](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/docs/wiki/how-to/remove-a-module.md).

## Skills in a generated project

- [saasaloy-setup](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/packages/cli/templates/base/_agents/skills/saasaloy-setup/SKILL.md): the interview, the read-back, the brief's completeness rule, and the [spec template](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/packages/cli/templates/base/_agents/skills/saasaloy-setup/product-spec-template.md) with its fixed headings.
- [saasaloy-design](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/packages/cli/templates/base/_agents/skills/saasaloy-design/SKILL.md): the design proposal, mockup review and approved theme.
- [saasaloy-build](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/packages/cli/templates/base/_agents/skills/saasaloy-build/SKILL.md): the staged MVP build from the brief and the spec.
- [saasaloy-feature](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/packages/cli/templates/base/_agents/skills/saasaloy-feature/SKILL.md): one product entity across the stack, from its table in the spec.
- [saasaloy-update](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/packages/cli/templates/base/_agents/skills/saasaloy-update/SKILL.md): the upgrade to a newer CLI, the update report, conflict markers, update notes, and the exit codes.
- [saasaloy-report](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/packages/cli/templates/base/_agents/skills/saasaloy-report/SKILL.md): report a Saasaloy failure upstream, with the facts, the source at the CLI's release tag, a search for a known issue, and a post only after the owner's yes. `saasaloy skill saasaloy-report` prints the copy the running CLI ships.
- [saasaloy-deploy](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/packages/cli/templates/base/_agents/skills/saasaloy-deploy/SKILL.md): the release, the gated deploy, the first superadmin, and answering a production question against the last deploy tag.
- [saasaloy-prod-debug](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/modules/database-postgres/skills/saasaloy-prod-debug/SKILL.md): with `database-postgres`, read production rows and the api logs, read-only, through `pnpm db:prod:query` and `pnpm logs:prod`.
- [The generated project's agent guide](https://github.com/mimukit/saasaloy/blob/main/packages/cli/templates/base/AGENTS.md): the rules for unattended work.
